description: Java source code for the 'Monkey' class, part of Android's testing framework, which injects random key events and actions into the Android system for testing purposes.

classes.name: Monkey
classes.description: Main class for Android's Monkey testing tool, which injects random events into the system.

classes.name: ActivityController
classes.description: Inner class implementing IActivityController.Stub to handle system callbacks for activity starting, crashing, ANR, and system not responding events.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point; sets process name and runs the monkey tool with provided arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the monkey testing cycles based on parsed command-line options.

methods.name: processOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure the monkey.

methods.name: loadPackageLists
methods.description: Loads allowed or disallowed package lists from files.

methods.name: getSystemInterfaces
methods.description: Connects to Android system services: ActivityManager, WindowManager, PackageManager.

methods.name: getMainApps
methods.description: Generates a list of main activities to target based on categories.

methods.name: runMonkeyCycles
methods.description: Main loop executing events, monitoring crashes, errors, and recording results.

methods.name: checkNativeCrashes
methods.description: Checks for new tombstone files indicating native crashes.
